crossRefs.note: Of Asher: Pagiel the son of Ochran.
On the eleventh day Pagiel the son of Ochran, prince of the children of Asher,
and for the sacrifice of peace offerings, two head of cattle, five rams, five male goats, and five male lambs a year…

people.name: Asher
people.line: Son of Jacob and Zilpah, founder of the tribe of Asher

people.name: Pagiel
people.line: Leader of the tribe of Asher

translations.web: “Those who encamp next to him shall be the tribe of Asher. The prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
translations.bsb: The tribe of Asher will camp next to it. The leader of the Asherites is Pagiel son of Ocran,
translations.kjv: And those that encamp by him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the captain of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ocran.
translations.asv: And those that encamp next unto him shall be the tribe of Asher: and the prince of the children of Asher shall be Pagiel the son of Ochran.
